svg.text: House map, Level 0: ground floor and yard
Working draft, to be tested in a greybox. Metres; origin = north-west corner of the plot, x east, y south. Grid 5 m.
Order board: burger orders; burgers are assembled here (Burgers)
Grill: the meat is fried here (Burgers)
Herb board: which icon marks which herb this round (Burgers)
Photo zone: the screen shows a pose silhouette (Photo)
Car on the lift: dropped, it kills whoever is under it (Car repair)
Lift control: no view of who is under the car (proposal) (Car repair)
Outdoor stairs behind the garage <-> passage to the generator hall
Main stairs: ground floor <-> second floor
U1 / D-1: goes up / down to that level
Voice carries 8 m; world sounds 12 m.
